subject: Evaluation kickoff: Finlytics trial plan and scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@finlytics.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today — evaluation kickoff

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about Finlytics' use case for transaction-level embeddings and anomaly detection. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Goal: Run a 4-week evaluation to validate latency/cost at your 3 workload profiles and measure quality on your prompt set.
- Success criteria: >= 95% availability during peak window, p50 latency < 120ms for generation endpoints, and embedding similarity recall >= 88% on the provided eval set.
- Primary stakeholders: Sarah (data science), Tom (infra), Connor (Redwood SE) on technical side.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (trial plan, deliverables, prompt set/evals, onboarding). Connor will lead the technical deep dive and environment checklist.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 26, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Aug 27, 09:00–10:00

I've attached a short one-page Eval Scope that outlines the trial plan and the artifacts we'll need (sample prompts, data access, success metrics). Can you confirm which slot works or suggest alternatives? Also let me know if anyone else from your team should join (procurement, security, etc.).

Attachment: Finlytics_Eval_Scope.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@finlytics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finlytics.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — evaluation kickoff

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap.

All looks good to me. Wed Aug 26, 14:00–15:00 PDT works best for our team. I'll invite Michael Grant (head of ML ops) — he's out this afternoon but can join on Wed. Tom will be on the call to cover infra/questions about VPC connectivity.

A couple quick Qs before the kickoff:
- For the embedding recall test, can you confirm the format you prefer for the eval set (CSV with id, text)?
- Any pre-reqs for network allowlists we should send to our security team before the call?

I'll go ahead and pencil Wed and send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Data Scientist, Finlytics
sarah.bennett@finlytics.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@finlytics.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — evaluation kickoff

Perfect — Wed Aug 26, 14:00–15:00 PDT is confirmed on our side. Thanks for looping Michael in.

Quick answers to your questions: 
- Eval set format: CSV with columns [id, text, label(optional)] is perfect. If you have JSONL that's also fine. We'll share a short template in a follow-up.
- Network allowlist: we'll send IP ranges and hostnames (redwood-inference.com) in a separate email before Monday so your security team can review. No VPC peering required for the initial eval (we can discuss for Dedicated later).

Connor — can you prepare the tech checklist and a short deck (10–12 slides) covering: infra requirements, sample request/response shapes, and common integration patterns? Also please attach the sample prompts workbook to the calendar invite.

Attaching updated prompt workbook we referenced.
Attachment: Finlytics_Sample_Prompts.xlsx (XLSX)

Sarah / Tom — I'll send a calendar invite with the call link and agenda shortly. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@finlytics.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today — evaluation kickoff

Thanks — confirmed for Wed 8/26 14:00 PDT. I'll put together the infra checklist, the 10-slide tech deck, and attach the sample prompts file to the invite. I'll also prepare a quick runbook for auth (API keys + optional KMS notes).
